tagline: Happy dogs, fresh haircuts, zero stress
intro: Gentle grooming and fun-packed day care for dogs of every shape and fluff level, five minutes from Brighton seafront.

highlights.label: dog on the table at a time

about_title: Run by dog people, for dogs
about:
Waggy Tails started in Jess's spare room with one very patient spaniel called Biscuit. Eight years on we have a bright shop in Kemptown, four groomers and a garden for the day care gang.

We only ever groom one dog at a time, we never use cages, and nervous dogs get as many breaks and biscuits as they need.

services.name: Full groom
services.description: Bath, blow dry, haircut, nails and ears. Priced by size and coat.

services.name: Bath and tidy
services.description: A good wash, dry and brush with a trim round the face, feet and tail.

services.name: Puppy's first groom
services.description: A gentle half hour to meet the dryer, the table and us. For pups under six months.

services.name: Day care
services.description: Small groups, a garden to tear around and a nap after lunch.

services.name: Nail clip
services.description: Ten minutes, no appointment needed on weekday mornings.

services.name: De-shed treatment
services.description: A deep wash and blow-out that takes the loose coat with it.

values.title: One at a time
values.text: Your dog gets a groomer's full attention from hello to goodbye.

values.title: No cages, ever
values.text: Dogs wait in the play room or on a comfy bed next to us.

values.title: Go at their pace
values.text: Nervous dogs get breaks, treats and a slower visit at no extra cost.

process.title: Say hello
process.text: A sniff around and a chat about the cut you would like.

process.title: Bath time
process.text: Warm water and shampoo chosen for their coat and skin.

process.title: Snip snip
process.text: Dry, brush and cut, with breaks whenever they are needed.

process.title: Ta-da
process.text: A photo, a treat and one very smart dog to take home.

faq.q: My dog is nervous. Is that OK?
faq.a: Very. Tell us when you book and we will plan a quieter slot and take things slowly.

faq.q: How long does a groom take?
faq.a: Between ninety minutes and three hours depending on size and coat. We text you when they are ready.

faq.q: How often should my dog be groomed?
faq.a: Most coats do well every six to eight weeks. We will suggest what suits your dog.

faq.q: What do I need for day care?
faq.a: Up-to-date vaccinations and a short trial morning so everyone can make friends.
